rationale: Price is sitting at 83% of today's range near the session high ($18.70) with the last five 1-minute candles showing tight, indecisive action (range ~$0.06) and no clear directional momentum — the most recent candle actually pulled back slightly. With no news catalyst, the stock has already gapped up ~5% from prior close and run from the open low of $17.67 to $18.52, leaving limited reward-to-risk for a long near the high and no structural breakdown signal to justify a short. The elevated relative volume (4.22x) is notable but without a fresh catalyst or a clean technical setup forming, the risk/reward does not favor entry in either direction.
